evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced introductory: 3. The ordered median is introductory. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded MEXT sponsorship adds local educational credibility, but open-entry information-design content and limited security relevance fit introductory literacy rather than a technical security practitioner tier.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded information-design scope, zero-experience entry and introductory hint fit pre-professional literacy. MEXT sponsorship does not establish technical application-security capability where the record explicitly limits security relevance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded entry information-design scope has limited security relevance and no experience requirement. Ministry sponsorship supports the educational context, not a security-engineering rank.
